entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Mythical archangel of Alara and Bant's guardian angel who battled Malfegor before the Sundering and sacrificed herself to banish him.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Demon Asha battled and banished but could not slay.

entities.name: Cathedral of Bliss
entities.description: Seat Asha ruled; the position has been vacant since her death.

entities.name: Sundering
entities.description: Event before which Asha battled Malfegor.

events.summary: Asha sacrifices herself to banish Malfegor, though she was unable to slay him.
events.quote: She ultimately sacrificed herself to banish the demon

relations.quote: an archangel who was said to have battled Malfegor before the Sundering .

relations.note: She ruled it before she died.
relations.quote: Before she died, she ruled the Cathedral of Bliss
